project_type: Next.js 15 Enterprise SaaS - Carbon Accounting Platform
build_system: pnpm with Next.js 15, Turbopack for dev
test_framework: Vitest for unit/integration, Playwright for E2E
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to install deps. 2. Run pnpm build to verify Next.js builds. 3. Run pnpm test to run vitest tests. 4. Run pnpm lint to check linting.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/carbonledger-ai. 2. pnpm install. 3. Copy .env.example to .env.local. 4. pnpm dev to start development server.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to npm registry. Node.js v22. pnpm 10.28.1 available. No Docker daemon likely available but Dockerfile can be created for documentation. IMPORTANT: After installing Next.js, must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for latest API documentation before writing code.
contribution_requirements: Must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ after installing Next.js to understand latest APIs and breaking changes. Follow AGENTS.md workspace rule.
key_patterns: Greenfield project - establishing patterns: Clean Architecture with DDD, Repository Pattern, SOLID principles. Multi-tenant SaaS with RLS. Drizzle ORM for type-safe DB access. shadcn/ui for UI components. Server Components by default, Client Components only when needed.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/lib/ - shared libraries (db, auth, calculation engine, utils). src/components/ - React components (ui/ for shadcn, features/ for domain). src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions. src/constants/ - emission factors, unit conversions. docs/ - documentation. tests/ - test files. supabase/ - Supabase migrations and config.
